why: A delivers the core industrial look the client described: a dark aged-brown boxy leather sofa and a black metal swing-arm lamp, both cohesive with the wood-and-black-metal table and bookcase; its only miss is a grey rather than earth-tone rug. B's earth-tone seagrass rug is right, but its smooth cognac mid-century sofa and fabric-shaded arc lamp drift away from the industrial brief.
